title: Multi-day trip, second driver identified on day two
description: The real case is a trip lasting roughly 30 hours, with driver A identified early and driver B identified about a day later, still inside the same (very long), still-open trip. This fixture compresses that into minutes: the actual trip playback stays under 5 minutes (IGN_ON at 0, IGN_OFF at 170) to stay inside MAX_TRIP_SECONDS and to keep the test's wall-clock run short. Only driver B's identification is stretched: its atSec (26 hours = 93600) is deliberately far beyond the fixture's own compressed trip bounds, standing in for the real day-two timestamp, while its deliverAtSec (160) delivers it before the compressed trip's own IGN_OFF (170), so the trip is still genuinely open when it arrives, matching the real multi-day case this fixture stands in for. Must prove: the assignee moves once, to A, and stays there. Must NOT change: B's day-two identification must not move the assignee off A, per the PM rule that multi-day trips are not split and a second driver identified later in the same trip is discarded.

events.note: trip ends; compressed stand-in for a ~30 hour real trip

driver_identifications.note: day-two identification (claimed atSec = 26h, far beyond this fixture's compressed trip bounds); delivered before the compressed trip's own IGN_OFF (170) so the trip is still open when it arrives
